scenario: LEXP.7.3b — the escape hatch. The same widening written explicitly with `:: Float` ([LCST.4.1]) compiles, so the rule costs the author one cast rather than forbidding the operation. This is the does-not-over-fire half: a slot-type check that rejected the cast form would leave no way to widen at all.
rules_ds:
schema Reading scope logical:
    qty: Int key

schema Result scope ttl 1_h:
    val: Float

rule widen:
    Reading r
->
    emit Result val: r.qty :: Float
